与此同时，西方另外几个大国高层，看着直播画面，也都陷入不同沉思中。
过了没一会儿，这几位盟友国的最高首席互相通电话，商议当下局势的处理办法。
经过简单讨论，所有人一致同意动用武力。
既然他们这些西方大国头脑一直认为，来自东方威胁迟早一战，为何不趁现在。
如果再让华夏野蛮发展下去，谁敢说他们还压得住？
他们一直在等一个机会，一个冠冕堂皇、出师有名的机会，要让华夏在名誉以及国力上全面崩溃。
一声令下，四个航母编队向华夏湾岛方向驶出，按照行驶速度，最快的将在6小时后到达。
其余世界各地，不管是企业老板、金领、白领以及其他社会精英，或者是普通百姓、贫民窟、海边等等诸多地方，几乎都见证一艘钢铁巨兽被大火吞没。
世界各地民众反应不一样，有的用手捂住嘴巴，直呼不可思议，同时热泪盈眶。
有的干脆高兴跳起来，一边鼓掌一边大喊‘好耶！’。
还有的摔键盘砸电脑，大骂不可能，顺带着将华夏骂一顿，还将最恶毒的诅咒送给华夏。
前两者都是一些贫困国家，常年被丑啯欺侮扰乱，孩子们只能在炮火声中长大。
后者则是西方发达国家的老百姓，他们尊崇丑啯，一面用着华夏生产的商品，一边将华夏视作最有威胁敌人，可从古至今华夏都不曾侵略过他们，也不曾收割过他们韭菜。
正常人是不会给自己创造一个假想敌出来，这些个可怜的老百姓，是被洗脑出精神病了。
当公道的标准被人为篡改，将是一个民族的悲哀。
战斗机笔直冲向蓝天，速度越来越快，开启全力冲刺模式，如同一枚快速上升火箭。
下方，巡洋舰指挥仓里雷达本来已经将其锁定，但很快就由于飞行太高而失去信号。

最后一声响，战斗机绿色图标在所有雷达上消失，雷达瞬间安静，如同集体静默。
航母主舰被炸毁，最高将领老里昂和其余高层指挥官全部葬身祸害，巡洋舰、护卫舰上的众人本就心里发慌，现在雷达又突然静默，根本抓不住刽子手的踪迹。
半分钟前，所有人都希望把这架该死的战斗机打下来，能挽回一点颜面是一点，同时为死去的长官和战友报仇。
但这一刻，当战斗机从雷达上消失，从湛蓝的天空中杳无音讯，所有人都默默祈祷，这个刽子手最好就此收手不要再出现。
战斗机的先进与战斗力是一定的，但放在不同飞行员手中，就会有不同的发挥效果。
发挥出五成算是合格，发挥出七成算是优秀，王牌飞行员大概能发挥出八九成。
而只有一种人能发挥出十成甚至更多，林这种飞行员被称作钻石或者大师飞行员。
被这种飞行员盯上，对身在战场上的每个人而言都是地狱，如同死神的镰刀收割声名
没有人愿意死亡，活下去才能与家人团聚，才能享受荣耀，才能去做很多很多事。
可突然，天空中传来一声破空之音儿，尖锐如同音爆，紧跟着就看见一道虚影从天垂落……
一道虚影从天坠落，带着一阵炽热火光，如同划过天际的流星，照亮整个世界。
世界各地，天涯海角，无数双眼睛通过电视机注视到这道光。
互联网上更是无数人在同一时间敲下键盘，噼里啪啦打出一行字：我靠，刷大火箭了！
下一刻，爆炸声穿越天际，还差面上荡起一阵巨大冲击波，一整艘舰船被火海吞没。

Chapter 5726 This is not a fluke (page 1)
At the same time, senior officials of several other major Western countries also fell into different contemplations while watching the live broadcast.
After a while, the top chiefs of these allied countries called each other to discuss how to deal with the current situation.
After a brief discussion, everyone agreed to use force.
Since they, the Western powers, have always believed that the threat from the East will be fought sooner or later, why not take advantage of it now.
If China is allowed to continue its barbaric development, who dares to say that they can still suppress it?
They have been waiting for an opportunity, a high-sounding and famous opportunity to make China completely collapse in terms of reputation and national power.
With an order, the four aircraft carrier formations sailed towards Huaxia Bay Island. According to the driving speed, the fastest one will arrive in 6 hours.
The rest of the world, whether it is business owners, gold-collar workers, white-collar workers and other social elites, or ordinary people, slums, seaside and many other places, almost all witnessed a steel giant being engulfed by fire.
People around the world had different reactions. Some covered their mouths with their hands and exclaimed in disbelief, while tears filled their eyes.
Some simply jumped up with joy, clapped and shouted, ‘Okay! ’.
Others smashed keyboards and computers, yelled that it was impossible, scolded China, and sent the most vicious curse to China.
The first two are poor countries that have been harassed by ugly bullies all year round, and their children can only grow up under the sound of gunfire.
The latter are common people in developed Western countries. They respect Chou Gao. While using the goods produced by China, they regard China as the most threatening enemy. However, China has never invaded them or harvested their leeks since ancient times.
Normal people would not create an imaginary enemy for themselves. These poor people have been brainwashed and become mentally ill.
When the standards of fairness are artificially tampered with, it will be a nation's tragedy.
The fighter jet rushed straight into the blue sky, getting faster and faster, turning on its full sprint mode, like a rapidly rising rocket.
Below, the radar in the cruiser's command cabin had locked onto it, but soon lost its signal due to flying too high.
With the last sound, the green fighter icon disappeared from all radars, and the radars were silent for an instant, like a collective silence.
The aircraft carrier's main ship was blown up, and the top general, Old Lyon, and other top commanders were all killed. Everyone on the cruiser and frigate was already panicking, and now the radar suddenly went silent, unable to catch the traces of the executioner.
Half a minute ago, everyone hoped to shoot down this damn fighter jet, save a little face, and at the same time avenge the dead commanders and comrades.
But at this moment, when the fighter jet disappeared from the radar and there was no sound from the blue sky, everyone prayed silently that this executioner had better stop and never appear again.
The advancement and combat effectiveness of fighter jets are certain, but in the hands of different pilots, they will have different effects.
A performance of 50% is considered qualified, a performance of 70% is considered excellent, and an ace pilot can probably perform 80% to 90%.
There is only one kind of person who can perform 100% or more. Pilots like Lin are called diamond or master pilots.
Being targeted by such a pilot is hell for everyone on the battlefield, just like the scythe of death harvesting reputation.
No one wants to die. Only by living can you be reunited with your family, enjoy glory, and do many, many things.
But suddenly, there was a piercing sound in the sky, as sharp as a sonic boom, and then a shadow was seen falling from the sky...
A shadow fell from the sky, bringing with it a burst of blazing fire, likeMeteors streak across the sky, lighting up the whole world.
From all over the world, countless pairs of eyes gazed at this light through television sets.
Countless people on the Internet were typing on the keyboard at the same time, typing out a line of words: Holy shit, it’s a big rocket!
The next moment, the explosion sounded across the sky, and a huge shock wave was heard on the surface, and the entire ship was engulfed in a sea of ​​fire.
